summary: Unlink Device feature — full E2E verification PASS. BACKEND (preview URL): the four required suites via `python -m pytest tests/test_family_unlink.py tests/test_family.py tests/test_family_weekly.py tests/test_family_incidents.py -q` → the NEW test_family_unlink.py 3/3 PASS (protected removes watcher; guardian stops watching + strangers get 404/403; re-pair after unlink). test_family_weekly.py and test_family_incidents.py pass clean. test_family.py has 1 xdist-ordering race (TestSharedEvents.test_barking_event_shared) plus 3 environmental Resend rate-limit failures on TestGuardians — both pre-existing and explicitly called out in the review request ('environmental' / prior iterations). Serially (-n 0) all 25/25 tests PASS in 20.3s, confirming the failures are xdist/env, not behaviour regressions. FRONTEND E2E (two isolated browser contexts on 390x844, real preview URL, mock adapter): (0) Both contexts onboarded via onboarding-start-button → disclosure-accept-button; apollo.device.identity.v2 populated in each (162-byte JSON). (1) A set owner name 'Mum' via family-owner-name, tapped family-make-code → family-pair-code rendered (e.g. 'HW6WQT'). (2) B entered code in family-link-code + family-link-button → toast 'Now watching a family member' visible. (3) A refetched /family: watcher row family-watcher-<link_id> present with label 'A family member', 'Paired 9/7/2026' and a Remove button family-watcher-remove-<link_id>. (4) B refetched /family: row family-watch-<A_device_id> present with Stop button family-watch-stop-<A_device_id> visible. (5) A checked https://phishing.apollo.test/login via home-check-link-button → within 7 s B's /family showed 'phishing.apollo.test' under Alerts from people you watch. (6) A tapped Remove; web confirm auto-accepted via page.on('dialog',dialog.accept) → toast 'Pairing removed. That phone no longer receives alerts.' visible; text 'No devices linked yet.' present; watcher testID gone. (7) B refetched /family: i_watch rows empty. (8) A then checked https://malware.apollo.test/x → after 7 s B refetched /family and 'malware.apollo.test' was ABSENT (fan-out correctly stopped by soft-deleted link). (9) Re-pair: A generated fresh code 'ET36XF'; B linked; A saw a new watcher row again. (10) B tapped family-watch-stop-<A_id>; confirm accepted; B's i_watch rows became empty; A's /family showed 'No devices linked yet.' (11) API boundary tests (stranger DELETE /api/family/links/<link_id>?device_id=<own> → 404; using A's id with the stranger's bearer → 403; malformed link_id → 404; second delete of already-removed link → 404) are ALL asserted in test_family_unlink.py::test_guardian_can_stop_watching_and_strangers_cannot_touch_a_link and PASS. No React Native red-screen, no console errors, no deprecated packages introduced.

minor.issue: xdist loadscope race: TestSharedEvents may run on gw1 before TestPairing runs on gw0 (shared DEVICE_A/DEVICE_B module state), so the fanout is emitted before the pair exists. Pre-existing test-infra issue, not a product bug. Passes cleanly with `-n 0`. Not caused by the unlink feature.

Environmental: Resend relay rate-limits guardian-invite emails intermittently → 502 from /api/family/guardians. Review request explicitly permits this ('may 502 if the Resend relay is rate-limited: environmental'). Not caused by the unlink feature.

ui_bugs.issue: Grammar bug: singular value renders as '1 device receive your alerts.' (missing subject-verb agreement). The review expected '1 device receives your alerts.'. Cause: template only pluralises 'device', not the verb: `${n} device${n>1?'s':''} receive your alerts.`. Fix: `${n} device${n>1?'s':''} receive${n===1?'s':''} your alerts.` or split branches. Everything else (row, testIDs, Remove button, unlink toast, empty-state copy) is correct.

action_items: Fix the singular-form grammar in /app/frontend/app/family.tsx line 155: current output for a single watcher is '1 device receive your alerts.' — should be '1 device receives your alerts.' Change the template to also gate the verb: `${n} device${n>1?'s':''} ${n===1?'receives':'receive'} your alerts.`

Optional test-infra polish (not blocking this feature): tests/test_family.py::TestSharedEvents relies on TestPairing having run first — under `-n 2 --dist loadscope` the two classes land on different xdist workers and race. Either merge the two classes, add an explicit setup that pairs inside TestSharedEvents, or mark the file with pytest-xdist's `pytest.mark.xdist_group`.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/family.py:unlink_device (lines 206-220): correct soft-delete semantics — filters on `deleted_at:None` and `$or:[{protected_device_id:device_id},{guardian_device_id:device_id}]`, so both sides of a pairing can end it and neither side can touch a pairing they aren't part of. ObjectId parse errors are mapped to a friendly 404 'Unknown pairing.' rather than 500. Second DELETE returns 404 as expected (already gone).

routers/family.py:notify_guardians and family_links.find queries throughout consistently filter `deleted_at:None` — verified live that after unlink, /family/shared-events for the guardian no longer receives new fan-outs (malware.apollo.test test), and /family/weekly returns [] for the guardian.

frontend/app/family.tsx: web-only confirm dialog uses `globalThis.confirm(...)` which Playwright's page.on('dialog', dialog.accept) intercepts correctly. Non-web path falls through to React Native Alert.alert — sound. Toast copy matches the spec exactly: 'Pairing removed. That phone no longer receives alerts.'

frontend/app/family.tsx: privacy-preserving watcher row — no guardian device_id leaks; only link_id + guardian_label + since + last_checkin_at are returned (validated in backend test_protected_person_removes_a_watcher line 40).
Minor grammar bug on line 155 (see ui_bugs above).

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only: 4 anonymous devices registered during this run (2 for pytest_iter34.xml + 2 fresh browser contexts for E2E); 2 pair codes generated + 2 links created + 2 patrol events (phishing.apollo.test, malware.apollo.test) + 1 unlink-then-repair sequence. All bounded to the short-lived anonymous device ids. No writes to seeded blocklist or admin data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unlink Device is fully wired end-to-end and behaves exactly per spec: both sides can end a pairing, the other device stops receiving fan-outs immediately (verified live with malware.apollo.test post-unlink NOT arriving at B), and re-pair with a fresh code restores watch. Playwright note: window.confirm on web is intercepted with `pg.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.create_task(d.accept()))` — Playwright's dialog handler must be attached BEFORE clicking Remove/Stop, else the click hangs. The two-context flow needs `browser = page.context.browser; ctx = await browser.new_context()` since `browser` isn't in the injected globals of this environment. tests/test_family.py has a pre-existing xdist ordering race (TestSharedEvents on gw1 races TestPairing on gw0) plus intermittent Resend 502 rate-limits on TestGuardians — both are environmental/legacy and NOT caused by the unlink feature. The one cosmetic bug to fix is family.tsx:155 — singular form reads '1 device receive your alerts.' (missing 's' on 'receives').
rca_of_issue: Not a bug — feature verification. The Unlink flow's contract is: server soft-deletes the family_links doc (sets deleted_at) and everywhere else in family.py the queries filter `deleted_at:None`, so fan-outs (notify_guardians, weekly rollups, shared-events listing) all stop atomically. The 204 status on success + 404 on already-deleted/unknown link + 403 on token-vs-claimed-id mismatch is preserved by the auth middleware (X-Apollo-Raw:1 bypass shown in test_family_unlink.py). Cosmetic side-issue on the client: family.tsx line 155 only pluralises 'device', not the verb — fix noted.
